description: Source code defining an abstract class and multiple concrete classes for reading various data types from Apache Arrow vectors within Spark, including handling of different vector types, data conversions, and formatting utilities.

classes.name: ArrowVectorReader
classes.description: Abstract class for reading leaf values from an Arrow vector, with methods for various data types.

classes.name: NullVectorReader
classes.description: Singleton object representing a null vector reader that always returns null.

classes.name: TypedArrowVectorReader
classes.description: Generic base class for specific Arrow vector type readers, providing null checking.

classes.name: BitVectorReader
classes.description: Reads boolean values from a BitVector.

classes.name: TinyIntVectorReader
classes.description: Reads byte-sized integers from a TinyIntVector.

classes.name: SmallIntVectorReader
classes.description: Reads small integers from a SmallIntVector.

classes.name: IntVectorReader
classes.description: Reads integers from an IntVector.

classes.name: BigIntVectorReader
classes.description: Reads long integers from a BigIntVector, with conversions to timestamp and instant.

classes.name: Float4VectorReader
classes.description: Reads float values from a Float4Vector.

classes.name: Float8VectorReader
classes.description: Reads double values from a Float8Vector.

classes.name: DecimalVectorReader
classes.description: Reads decimal values from a DecimalVector, with precise conversions.

classes.name: VarCharVectorReader
classes.description: Reads string values from a VarCharVector.

classes.name: LargeVarCharVectorReader
classes.description: Reads string values from a LargeVarCharVector.

classes.name: VarBinaryVectorReader
classes.description: Reads byte arrays from a VarBinaryVector.

classes.name: LargeVarBinaryVectorReader
classes.description: Reads byte arrays from a LargeVarBinaryVector.

classes.name: DurationVectorReader
classes.description: Reads Duration objects and formats them as interval strings.

classes.name: IntervalYearVectorReader
classes.description: Reads YearMonthInterval data and formats as interval strings.

classes.name: DateDayVectorReader
classes.description: Reads date values from a DateDayVector, converting days to various date/time representations.

classes.name: TimeStampMicroTZVectorReader
classes.description: Reads timestamp with timezone data, converting to various date/time formats.

classes.name: TimeStampMicroVectorReader
classes.description: Reads timestamp data with timezone adjustments.

classes.name: TimeVectorReader
classes.description: Reads local time values and formats as strings.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Factory method to create an appropriate ArrowVectorReader instance based on vector type and target data type.
